# Futexes

Waiting on a word and waking its waiters through `futex`.

<h2 id="futex-wait-private"><code>FutexWaitPrivate</code></h2>

```rux
pub const FutexWaitPrivate: int32 = 128;
```

`FUTEX_WAIT_PRIVATE`: sleep while the word holds the expected value.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Futex.rux#L21)

<h2 id="futex-wake-private"><code>FutexWakePrivate</code></h2>

```rux
pub const FutexWakePrivate: int32 = 129;
```

`FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE`: wake threads sleeping on the word.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Futex.rux#L25)

<h2 id="futex-wait"><code>FutexWait</code></h2>

```rux
pub func FutexWait(
    address: *uint32,
    expected: uint32,
    timeout: *Timespec
) -> int64
```

Sleeps while `*address` equals `expected`, until a wake, a signal or the timeout.
Returns at once with `-EAGAIN` when the word already differs, which is how a caller learns it changed.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/futex.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/futex.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Futex.rux#L35)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type        | Description                                                                |
| ---------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `address`  | `*uint32`   | the word to wait on, four-byte aligned                                     |
| `expected` | `uint32`    | the value the caller last saw there                                        |
| `timeout`  | `*Timespec` | how long to wait at most, relative to now, or null to wait without a limit |

**Returns**: zero after a wake, or a negative error number: [`EAGAIN`](/docs/api/linux/errors#eagain), [`EINTR`](/docs/api/linux/errors#eintr) or [`ETIMEDOUT`](/docs/api/linux/errors#etimedout)

<h2 id="futex-wake"><code>FutexWake</code></h2>

```rux
pub func FutexWake(address: *uint32, count: int32) -> int64
```

Wakes up to `count` threads sleeping on `address`.

**See also**: [https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/futex.2.html](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/futex.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Linux/Src/Futex.rux#L46)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type      | Description              |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------ |
| `address` | `*uint32` | the word they wait on    |
| `count`   | `int32`   | how many to wake at most |

**Returns**: how many were woken, or a negative error number
